## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

---

## 🎯 Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a specific problem or educational/production use case?
*Example: I am always frustrated when trying to integrate Apache Hive with HDFS without extra environment configs.*

---

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any potential Docker, Compose, script, or configuration changes.

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

---

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, documentation references, or examples about the feature request here.
